name: Claim soon after policy inception
description: The claim was lodged within a short window of the policy starting. A legitimate explanation is common; it is a prompt to look, not a conclusion.

name: Recent cover increase
description: Cover was changed shortly before the date of loss.

name: Repeat claims for the same peril
description: Two or more prior claims for the same peril in the recent history window.

name: Prior declined claim
description: A previous claim on this customer's history was declined. Context for the reviewer, not evidence about this claim.

name: Risk previously flagged
description: A prior claim in this customer's history was itself flagged for risk review.

name: Estimate inconsistent with described damage
description: The customer's overall estimate is far above the sum of the itemised estimates, or is high relative to a small number of described items.

name: Damage description lacks specificity
description: The description is unusually short or generic for the value claimed. A weak signal on its own.

name: Claim value close to or above the sum insured
description: The estimated value approaches the dwelling or contents sum insured.
